title: Barclays UK Corporate Bank joins £1 billion social housing retrofit mobilisation
summary: Barclays UK Corporate Bank is participating in a £1 billion funding mobilisation alongside the National Wealth Fund to support retrofit and sustainability investment in the social housing sector. The initiative is designed to accelerate improvements to existing homes while maintaining access to long-dated finance for housing associations. The programme reflects growing lender engagement with net-zero aligned housing infrastructure.
